scene: The rune flashes bright, opening three humming transport docks behind the gate.
picture: A flat side view along a wide stone wharf. On the left rests a moored solar-sail junk. The Pacific Islander man in his floral shirt and sandals with ukulele stands centre. Up high dangles a round cable pod above an iron boarding deck. On the far right waits a sleek, glowing bullet train with open doors.
shown: A wooden solar-sail junk moored at a glowing canal dock on the far left. Wait, the junk is docked and ready on the left.
A circular cloud cable pod suspended from a shining ropeway up high.
A sleek bullet train with an open illuminated doorway waiting on the far right.
